name: spinner
description: Work in progress, as a shape. Paired with the button's `loading` state rather than its `disabled` one, because dimming a control to say `this is happening` reads as `you may not do this`.

reducedMotion.$description: A spinner cannot fade instead of moving — a still spinner says nothing. Under `reduce` it slows to a rate that reads as alive without spinning fast enough to trigger vestibular symptoms.

a11y.note: `role=status` announces politely, once, on appearance. The label is required: `aria-label` is the only thing a screen reader has, because the icon is `aria-hidden` geometry.
